claims: Under international law, a blockade must be effective (actually enforced, not just declared).
Under international law, a blockade must be impartial.
Under international law, a blockade must be formally declared.
A paper blockade is invalid, according to Britannica.
Modern international law dictates that a blockade is prohibited if its sole purpose is to starve civilians, as explained on ABC News.
A blockade is distinct from a siege, as noted on Wikipedia.
A siege focuses on surrounding a specific fortification, as noted on Wikipedia.
